data.title: 忍冬 · 御守的针脚
data.description: 御守的边角有一道旧裂口。忍冬把线头藏进布里，缝完又检查了一遍，才把小小的护身符重新系好。
data.action: 仔细缝补旧御守的边缘
data.camera: 近景，针线与御守在画面中央
data.promptProse: Sitting near a quiet window at a small antique side table, Vulpisfoglia delicately stitches the frayed silk corner of an ornate woven protection amulet with needle and gold thread. Soft late-afternoon sunbeams highlight the focused precision in her sharp eyes, while scattered thread spools, silver shears, and her calm posture show a deeply grounded, unexpected domestic care.
